author: Rivzz
body:
I know this isn't a player, but I didn't know where exactly to put a bug report!

Basically, under certain circumstances... if you die in Deathmatch (Zao) you can still show your bow if you have an arrow in your inventory. This glitch in particular, ruins the map Zao because you can one shot anyone with your bow!

I have some video evidence here » https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VJh5OXtZ4qE&feature=youtu.be

Regards,
Michael (Rivzz)

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Heeya Rivzz,

Thanks for reporting that bug!

Yet, as you already noticed this is not the right subforum. Please use our issue tracker on github in the future: avicus.net/issues
Fortunately there is already an issue regarding that bug, so the devs already know about that.
Since you linked a video, I'll go ahead and post it on the issue in the hopes the devs know how to recreate and ultimately fix it.

Thank you very much for helping to improve the server!

Regards Flo/resepignev
